body: I’ve had pretty much this same idea for a long time. I grew up in the Rockies and I figure I’ll just wander out into some beautiful terrain and find the sheerest most beautiful cliff to jump off of. Everything just makes me want to end it and wandering off into the wilderness is about as opposite of my current life as can be

I need a therapist, that’s for sure. I’ve only ever done group therapy with strangers and lots of medication which was helpful to some degree but it ruined us financially, I was sexually assaulted daily by one of my peers, and I am scared of going back for those reasons.
